name: A multi option list picks Mandarin but not Other
spec_quote: E.g. label "Languages Spoken", type multi, options Spanish / French / Mandarin / Other → "Mandarin" (English has no option; "Other" is NOT picked).

name: A option list joins profile-order picks with pipe
spec_quote: Options English / Mandarin / Spanish → "Mandarin | English".

name: A exact-start option beats earlier containing option
spec_quote: For each profile language, in profile order, pick the option that starts with it, else the first option containing it; answer = picks joined by " | ".

name: A profile language with no matching option is omitted
spec_quote: A profile language with no matching option is simply not picked (never invent an option).

name: A plural label combo list is answered as option list
spec_quote: A. Option lists (multi / checkbox, or a plural label) — existing behaviour, must stay

name: A checkbox language list is answered
spec_quote: At least two options name a language and no option is a level code (A1..C2).

name: A containing but not starting option is used when needed
spec_quote: pick the option that starts with it, else the first option containing it

name: A option list with a level code is not answered
spec_quote: At least two options name a language and no option is a level code (A1..C2).

name: A option list with fewer than two language options is not answered
spec_quote: At least two options name a language

name: B textarea asking which languages you speak lists all profile languages
spec_quote: answers with every profile language NAME, in profile order, joined by ", ": "Chinese (Mandarin), English".

name: B text languages you know lists all profile languages
spec_quote: the label contains "language" or "languages" or "language(s)" AND one of: spoken, speak, speaks, fluent, know, list

name: B spoken label lists all profile languages

name: B other than English excludes English

field.label: Other than English, which languages do you speak?

spec_quote: If the label says "other than English" (or "besides English", "apart from English"), leave out English: "Chinese (Mandarin)".

name: B besides English excludes English
spec_quote: If the label says "other than English" (or "besides English", "apart from English"), leave out English: "Chinese (Mandarin)".

name: B apart from English excludes English

field.label: Apart from English, which languages are you fluent in?

spec_quote: If the label says "other than English" (or "besides English", "apart from English"), leave out English: "Chinese (Mandarin)".
